text:
Miro Heiskanen has not played since Nov. 3, when he left a 6-5 win in Washington early in the second period after being hit into the boards by Justin Sourdif. He has missed five games with an upper-body injury, and NHL.com lists him as questionable for Tuesday's first of two games in Vegas. Coach Glen Gulutzan said the hope is he returns this week.

Before he went down he looked like himself: 11 points in 15 games, 24:53 a night, and Dallas taking 57% of the expected goals with him at five on five, almost seven points better than without him. His goals (three on 1.61 expected) ran a little hot, but the assists and the minutes are the real value.

The Stars have held up. Pro Hockey Rumors noted they took five of eight points in his first four missed games, with Thomas Harley, Esa Lindell and Nils Lundkvist absorbing the load. But the blue line is thinning: Lian Bichsel is on injured reserve and Tyler Myers left Sunday's game hurt. Evolving-Hockey had Heiskanen 12th among defensemen last season, much of it on the power play. Watch his minutes in the first game back.
headline: Dallas has managed without Heiskanen, for now
